sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/hancock-campground ('Hancock Campground has 56 wooded sites'); recreation.gov catalog (54 listed): RV permitted on 33 sites (23-41, 43-56), tent only on 1-21; only 52 carries a length (RV 35 ft)

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/hancock-campground ('Flush toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site'); recreation.gov amenities 'Drinking Water (hand pump)', 'Flush Toilets', 'Vault Toilets'

values.note: recreation.gov sells the peak season (2026: May 22 to October 11; 2027: May 20 to October 11); outside it the sites are first-come at the same $30. Reserved sites are held until noon the day after arrival.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/hancock-campground ('Some sites can be reserved online or by calling Toll Free 1-877-444-6777 ... Other sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10300159 rates ('Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-10-11', 'Peak Season 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-11', 'First-come, First-served Season 2026-10-12 to 2026-12-31' at $30) and notices; catalog: 23 of 54 sites reservable (15 RV-permitted, 8 walk-in tent)

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/hancock-campground ('Single Site: $30 per night'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $6 per vehicle per night'); https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10300159 rates ($30 PeakStandard and walk-in seasons 2026-2028) and notice ('Site fee includes one RV with tow vehicle ... a third vehicle would be an additional fee')

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/whitemountain/recreation/hancock-campground ('Senior and Access pass holders receive a 50% discount')

note:
Wooded sites along the Pemigewasset River, some of which are right on the water's edge.  Reservations website does not properly distinguish between tent-only and RV sites.  Call the campground to clarify.  --AWH
recreation.gov now permits RVs on sites 23-56 (only 52 carries a length, 35 ft); 1-21 are tent sites. The sites nearest the river are 49, 51, 52 and 54, on the south side of the loop. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov confirm 56 sites, $30 (+$6 vehicle past RV+tow), flush toilets and hand-pump water, some sites reservable in the peak season and first-come otherwise; open year round (manual season untouched). rec.gov now permits RVs on 33 sites (23-56). --AWH riverfront agrees with the site points (49/51/52/54 ~15-35 m from the East Branch). Note gets a --Claude line; AWH text kept.
flags: Waterfront (--AWH riverfront, not changed): agrees with the pages. recreation.gov's site points put the south-side RV sites 51 (44.06308,-71.59617), 52 (44.06312,-71.59544), 54 (44.06326,-71.59499) and 49 (44.06324,-71.59655) about 15-35 m from the north edge of the East Branch Pemigewasset, a rocky channel ~40-60 m wide on Esri imagery (riverfront, not creekside). Canopy hides the bank, so the walk down is not measured; AWH's own 'right on the water's edge' stands.

Rig length: recreation.gov permits RV on sites 23-41 and 43-56 (33 sites, 15 reservable) but gives no length except site 52 (RV 35 ft); no FS length limit or RV warning. The AWH note's 'call the campground' caveat still fits.

Kancamagus/WMNF pass: the FS campground page is silent; the FS passes page says forest campgrounds 'are managed by concessionaire and are not covered by the recreation pass', so the campground fee covers the stay; parking at listed day-use fee sites (e.g. Lincoln Woods) needs the pass.
FS alert banner lists a 'Lincoln Woods Trail Closure' (trail, not the campground); no campground closure.
Phone 802-289-0970 is the concessionaire line recreation.gov gives ('For facility specific information, please call (802) 289-0970') - kept. Website unchanged (both lines load).
